[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Container With Most Water** [LC 11 · Container With Most Water](https://leetcode.com/problems/container-with-most-water/){difficulty="Medium"}

The area is a product of a *width* and the *shorter* wall. Starting at the widest possible span ($\mathit{lo}=0$, $\mathit{hi}=n-1$) and moving one pointer inward always shrinks the width by one, so the only way the area could still grow is if the height grows enough to pay for the lost width — and the height that can grow is the **shorter** wall's. Moving the taller wall inward keeps $\min$ the same (or worse) at a narrower span, a provably no-better choice; so you discard the shorter wall every step and never the wrong one.

[Solved in full in @sec-tp-p1-b.]{.card-link}

:::
